name: Share feature counts
author: wizard
description: Once an hour this box sends the team only which app features under test were tried and your thumbs up or down on them, with a random box id and nothing else (no names, content or identity), so the Tracker can show Tried by N and thumbs counts. The shell reads each app's own Try new features state and the App Manager (wam/switch_feedback.py) sends the counts; nothing on screen changes.
